targets.rawSql: SELECT health_status AS `Platform health` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_platform_health_latest LIMIT 1
SELECT health_status AS `Daily pipeline health` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_operational_debt_latest WHERE debt_key = 'latest_daily_pipeline' LIMIT 1
SELECT health_status AS `Backup health` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_backup_health_latest LIMIT 1

panels.description: No rows means there is no current WARNING, CRITICAL or UNKNOWN operational debt.

targets.rawSql: SELECT health_status AS `Severity`, debt_domain AS `Domain`, debt_key AS `Condition`, item_count AS `Affected items`, summary AS `Summary`, observed_at_utc AS `Observed (UTC)` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_operational_debt_latest WHERE health_status <> 'HEALTHY' ORDER BY CASE health_status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 2 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, debt_domain, debt_key LIMIT 100

panels.title: Conditions requiring attention

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_run_id AS `Run`, execution_mode AS `Mode`, trigger_type AS `Trigger`, run_status AS `Execution`, health_status AS `Health`, started_at_utc AS `Started (UTC)`, completed_at_utc AS `Completed (UTC)`, duration_seconds AS `Seconds`, failure_class AS `Failure class` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_pipeline_run_history WHERE pipeline_name = 'daily-platform' AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC, pipeline_run_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Select a recent daily pipeline run using the dashboard control.

targets.rawSql: SELECT phase_ordinal AS `Order`, phase_name AS `Phase`, phase_status AS `Execution`, health_status AS `Health`, started_at_utc AS `Started (UTC)`, completed_at_utc AS `Completed (UTC)`, duration_seconds AS `Seconds`, notifications_queued AS `Queued`, notifications_sent AS `Sent`, notifications_failed AS `Failed` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_pipeline_phase_history WHERE pipeline_run_id = CAST(${pipeline_run_id:sqlstring} AS UNSIGNED) AND $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) ORDER BY phase_ordinal LIMIT 50

panels.title: Pipeline phases

targets.rawSql: SELECT validation_run_id AS `Validation`, validation_scope AS `Scope`, run_mode AS `Mode`, run_status AS `Execution`, validation_outcome AS `Outcome`, health_status AS `Health`, started_at_utc AS `Started (UTC)`, completed_at_utc AS `Completed (UTC)`, duration_seconds AS `Seconds`, passed_check_count AS `Passed`, failed_check_count AS `Failed`, skipped_check_count AS `Skipped`, issue_count AS `Issues` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_validation_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC, validation_run_id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT backup_attempt_id AS `Attempt`, attempt_status AS `Status`, started_at_utc AS `Started (UTC)`, completed_at_utc AS `Completed (UTC)`, duration_seconds AS `Seconds`, is_complete_verified_recovery_point AS `Verified recovery point`, failure_class AS `Failure class`, failing_database AS `Database`, failing_operation AS `Operation`, final_attempt_number AS `Attempt number`, max_attempts AS `Maximum attempts`, partial_verified_file_count AS `Verified files`, recovery_point_at_utc AS `Recovery point (UTC)`, total_compressed_bytes AS `Compressed bytes` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_backup_history WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at_utc) ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC, backup_attempt_id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT failed_run_entity_id AS `Failed entity`, failed_run_id AS `ETL run`, pipeline_run_id AS `Pipeline run`, source_name AS `Source`, entity_name AS `Entity`, failure_started_at_utc AS `Failed (UTC)`, earliest_failed_request_start_date AS `Window start`, latest_failed_request_end_date AS `Window end`, failed_request_window_count AS `Failed windows`, covered_request_window_count AS `Covered windows`, recovery_status AS `Recovery`, recovery_completed_at_utc AS `Recovered (UTC)` FROM cycling_platform_admin.v_google_health_daily_ingestion_failure_history WHERE $__timeFilter(failure_started_at_utc) ORDER BY failure_started_at_utc DESC, failed_run_entity_id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Google Health ingestion incidents and recoveries
